findings_and_questions.classification: source-backed conditional authoritative interaction-boundary finding; unique count and priority centrally reconciled
findings_and_questions.first_contract: The ordinary client selects windows within 2 m in 3D and checks terrain visibility, but the authoritative ToggleWindow action takes a mapped window entity and calls a predicate based only on tangent/outward dot products, without repeating either client range or line-of-sight check in the displayed action path. Generated SceneWindow directions are lifted from the plan with y=0. A symbolic actor offset (0, 100, -1) from an axis-aligned window with tangent X and outward Z yields depth -1 and lateral 0, satisfying the source predicate despite the vertical distance.
findings_and_questions.condition_and_limits: A controlled player with an empty authoritative hand, admissible sequence/current revision and a mapped target entity must send the separately selected window to the server. Whether a different-floor or remote entity is replicated/mappable in the relevant session and actual action delivery were not established. The ordinary client selector uses the animated transform position for its 3D bound and terrain ray; the server uses the stored opening centre, so its eventual authoritative reach policy must account for this intentional distinction. No client manipulation, request, scene, runtime, product or test was executed.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Determine the authoritative target/reach and obstruction contract at the server boundary, re-evaluate current authoritative actor/window pose and permitted interaction volume while preserving legitimate windows, stale-state/ownership checks, and the deliberate inside-side semantics. Decide separately whether terrain visibility is an authoritative requirement.
relationships: The shared helper also serves door grabs, but this review establishes the assigned window action path only; do not automatically merge a door finding.

lenses.bounded_assessment: Debug and ECS Name are presentation diagnostics; window uses typed SceneBuildingId/OpeningAssemblyId and apse uses typed WallSourceId. The apparent string does not classify application behavior.

Window angular rate is named; the apse uses explicit index 4, five facets and 0.75 m eave floor tied to the authored basilica. The producer and consumers need their positional/physical contract rather than arbitrary wrapper extraction.

Window pose retains Scene frame positions and directions before controller projects them into raw native state; raw RoofPiece and WallLocalFrame source geometry become new polygon points. Existing checked owners are role/frame specific.

Canonical Position, PlanDirection, Radians and LeafDimensions exist and are carried through SceneWindowPose. Reuse them for retained same-value state only where they describe the actual authority; native actor positions and newly calculated polygon points remain separate admission cases.

Roof source ordinal selects an authored role, not a universal numeric role. Typed window/opening/scene identifiers and axes encode distinct meanings; 3D reach and inside-side depth are related but separate interaction requirements.

The controller advances/clamps signed angular state then uses quaternion rotation about hinge; 3D grab excludes height from dot products. Apse computes chord ends, normalized radial offset and tangent-based apex under input-specific geometric assumptions.

Window closed centre/hinge/tangent/yaw must agree for a no-jump reconstruction; individually admitted fields alone do not prove that relationship, while the shown generator derives them together. Five apse wall facets and their roof ordinal are a multi-record relationship.

WindowSpec wire checks leaves individually and SceneWindowPose admits converted values with source identity; authoritative action gates actor, sequence, state and empty hand, but shown grab predicate does not establish client 3D reach. Apse private helper depends on its producer scope.

Window open is a controller-local toggle over fixed kinematic movement; typed leaf/bar presence and ChurchApse facet tag retain meaningful modes. Ordinary fallback roof construction is a real alternate branch, not assumed legacy behavior.

WindowController hinge/open angle duplicate projections of the paired admitted pose and SceneWindow stores other geometry separately; 774 F003 tracks retention. Apse walls and roof-piece ordinal cooperate as one authored graph rather than automatically interchangeable sources.

P16 and current server file match individually; apse clean 6533 file matches current while its historical pr-working snapshot had unrelated dirty paths. Preserve valid inward swing, float/quaternion operation order, exact eave/normal/fallback policies and errors.

774 F002/F003 cover static grab-helper and controller retained checked-value losses respectively. 774 native F001 begins at later polygon bounds admission, not new apse arithmetic. No prior source proof becomes this reader’s original-lens credit.

WindowSpec custom serde admits individually checked fields with contextual errors; SceneWindow follows the same contextual pattern. Derive replacements cannot be inferred from individual attribute similarities or helper usage.
